title: Surface the ma_stack top-decile certified edge on Evidence + Research factor lab
rationale: Top NEW triad survivor (triad_score 1.230, #2 cell behind only the already-surfaced leadership_score). Scores on all three legs at once: positive return, the lowest drawdown among the strong-return survivors, and max frequency, with a POSITIVE stable rank-IC (the factor actually sorts forward returns). Hold-out edge +0.0262 > required 0.0031 (edge-persisted, 351 holdout dates). Trend-alignment factor; decile 10 = strongest MA stack. Promoted to J-06.

title: entry_quality_score bottom-decile inverse edge (contrarian)
rationale: Hold-out survivor (triad_score 0.861, holdout edge +0.0506) but NEGATIVE rank-IC: it is decile 1 (LOW entry quality) that outperforms, an INVERSE relationship to the score's intended semantic. Surfacing it as 'Proven' on the entry_quality_score badge would contradict the score's meaning and confuse the user, and its drawdown leg is weak (-0.1923). Robust survivor, NOT promoted this cycle (confusing/contradictory UX; revisit only as a clearly-labeled inverse-factor view).

title: high_proximity top-decile (near-52w-high) certified edge
rationale: Hold-out survivor with the BEST positive rank-IC among all survivors (+0.0265) and the smallest drawdown (-0.1063); intuitive (proximity to 52-week high leads). But its engine triad_score is negative (-0.062, ranked #4) — the project's combined lens does not favor it as strongly as ma_stack this batch. Robust survivor held in backlog; strong second candidate for a later cycle.

title: hv top-decile (high historical volatility) certified edge
rationale: Hold-out survivor (holdout edge +0.0539) but FAILS the drawdown leg badly (-0.2149, the deepest of any survivor) and has a negative rank-IC; triad_score -0.109. High return is paid for with high risk — poor on the triad's lower-drawdown leg. Robust but NOT promoted.

title: vcp_contraction top-decile certified edge
rationale: Hold-out survivor (holdout edge +0.0333) but negative rank-IC and modest return; triad_score -0.436. Robust but low usefulness by the lens — NOT promoted.

title: rs_spy_3m top-decile 60-day-horizon certified edge on Evidence + Research factor lab
rationale: Strongest hold-out edge (+0.2134) AND best positive rank-IC (+0.0274) of every cell in the scan; #2 triad survivor (0.541). Pre-registered multi-horizon candidate (proposer-guidance section 4.1 #3) with a recorded staging referee PASS (block-bootstrap p=0.00049975, well under the canonical divisor-7 bar 0.00714). Signal-less (rs_spy_3m is not one of the three score columns) so it backs the Research factor lab only and never a /stocks badge - the guidance-preferred kind, and a brand-new factor on the evidence surface. Promoted to J-09.

title: leadership_score top-decile 60-day-horizon certified edge (score-column anchor/fallback)
rationale: #1 triad survivor (0.667) and a pre-registered candidate (proposer-guidance section 4.1 #4) with a recorded staging referee PASS (p=0.00049975). NOT promoted this cycle: leadership_score is a SCORE COLUMN already surfaced (backs the /stocks leaderboard at h20; proven_signals={leadership_score}), so an h60 claim is the score-column anchor/fallback that interacts with the existing inline badge - lower novelty and more coherence surface than the signal-less rs_spy_3m. Held as the clean fallback for a focused follow-up cycle.

title: Factor evidence horizon term-structure panel (a factor's certified edge across h1/h5/h10/h20/h60 in one place)
rationale: STRUCTURAL/UX, not a data pattern: as multi-horizon canonical claims accumulate (vcp_contraction h20+h60, rs_spy_3m h60, leadership_score h20), a factor's Proven / Not-yet-proven status across all five horizons is scattered across separate factor-lab rows. A read-only panel that re-displays the SAME GET /api/evidence payload per horizon would make 'at which holds does this factor certify an edge?' legible at a glance (re-format only; no new module/endpoint). Premature until at least 3 factors carry multi-horizon claims; NOT promoted (speculative, not data-backed).

title: leadership_score top-decile 10-day-horizon certified edge (score-column multi-horizon survivor)
rationale: Hold-out survivor (holdout edge +0.0363 > required 0.0118, 284 holdout dates; triad_score 0.284). NOT promoted: with rs_spy_3m h60 (J-09) and vcp_contraction h60 (J-07) shipped and the combination winner shipped (J-08), the pre-registered guidance sec 4.1/4.2 candidate sets are EXHAUSTED - every member is now either a canonical journey or a closed referee FAIL (ma_stack), leaving only the leadership_score score-column multi-horizon cohorts. leadership_score is a SCORE COLUMN already surfaced as the proven /stocks flagship at h20 (proven_signals={leadership_score}). Because evidence._resolve_signal self-maps ANY leadership_score factor cohort to signal=leadership_score, an h10 (or h60) PASS entry would OVERWRITE proven_signals[leadership_score] (last-wins in build_evidence_payload, no horizon filter) and flip the J-01/J-02 /stocks drill-down off the intuitive h20 proof onto the 60/10-day claim - a regression surface on the flagship signal that the signal-less J-07/J-09 deliberately avoided (their builds were zero-app-source-change). Low novelty (2nd horizon badge on an already-proven factor) + a coherence change forced into the single canonical evidence resolver that three passing Must-haves depend on => held, not promoted.

Recorded for completeness; not promoted.

title: up_down_vol top-decile 60-day-horizon cell (ephemeral triad-screen survivor) — REJECTED, not promotable
rationale: Ephemeral triad-screen survivor ONLY (oos_survived on 26 holdout dates); NOT a proposal. (1) Not in the pre-registered proposer-guidance §4.1/§4.2 candidate set nor an owner-registered backlog card, so surfacing it would require an ad-hoc data-mined Evidence Claim — forbidden by anti-goal #4 and backlog §0 rule 1. (2) The referee economy is CLOSED (canonical Bonferroni divisor 8, required_p 0.00625; staging exhausted, next bar alpha8≈0.00039 below the block-bootstrap p-floor ≈0.0005), so any Evidence-Claim journey FAILs-and-blocks and only tightens the divisor 8→9 for no possible gain. (3) Fails the triad's low-drawdown leg (MDD -0.178) and barely sorts (rank_ic +0.017): a high up/down-volume high-beta long-horizon return — the compensated-risk artifact the 30-year plateau hunt already demonstrated to be an out-of-sample non-edge under the SPY control. Recorded to prevent re-mining on the next deterministic scan; honest stop.
